messages:
leah: FYI saw a small cluster of schema rejects for function hooks in prod-eu. They all got routed to the fallback worker and ate into the degen quota.
leah: alert: <https://ops/alerts/HOOK-SCHEMA-1748889999> 320 events / 15m
cesar: can you drop a redacted example? we need to know if it's a model surface issue or client adapter.
leah: here's one from the trace (redacted):
```
{"call": {"fn": "fetch_products", "args": {"items": [{"id": "p1"}, {"id": "p2"}]}}}
```
console schema expects: `{ call: { fn: string, args: { products: [...] } } }` — the model returned `items` instead of `products`.
tom: ah the plural/key mismatch. Is this coming from a single model variant or multiple?
leah: traces show model_variant=v4-small for ~90% of rejects. It seems the assistant output used legacy adapter naming.
ux-bot: note: we have strict-validation enabled for the "canary-eu" slice (10% traffic).
cesar: routing flow is strict -> reject -> route_to degen_pool -> degen consumes quota. Two problems: (1) billing attribution is still the original route, so canary shows inflated spend; (2) console doesn't show reject reason inline, so integrators just see throttles.
billing-bot: current billing tags: {route_tag, customer_id}. routed_to isn't part of billing tags.
tom: quick mitigation: change canary to soft-fail (log & route) for 30m while we triage, then re-enable strict once we have coercion rules.
leah: agree. Also propose telemetry changes: sample 2% of rejects, store `schema_diff:v1` with minimal context, redact PII, retention 14d for quicker debugging.
cesar: for console: show a sample diff UI with expected path highlighted, actual payload, and a suggested adapter snippet. Example suggestion for this case: `if payload.args.items then payload.args.products = payload.args.items` (opt-in). We should also surface a checkbox on canary to "auto-coerce non-breaking keys".
tom: billing fix: add routed_to -> billing pipeline mapping so cost attribution follows executing worker. Quick patch: emit sidecar tag `exec_worker=<routed_to>` and have billing pipeline join on that.
leah: lowered priority: build a library of safe coercions, attach confidence score, and only auto-apply when confidence > 0.9. Manual opt-in first.
cesar: action items:
  - tom: push exec_worker tag to the billing emitter (PR in 30m)
  - leah: toggle canary from strict->soft for 30m and post metrics
  - tom + ux-bot: add console instant filter `rejected_by:schema` and a one-click sample diff panel
  - cesar: wire up schema_reject_sample telemetry (2%) and make sure redaction runs in the ingestion lambda
  - ux-bot: draft UI copy for suggested adapter flows
oms-bot: reminder: if degen quota >85% trigger #release-war-room (manual pause until owners ack).
leah: i'll monitor and reopen thread if it resurfaces. thanks all. :thumbsup:
